# American Airlines

> > American Airlines official website providing flight bookings, baggage services, customer support, and travel management for passengers.

AA.com is the primary digital platform for American Airlines, one of the world's largest air carriers. The site serves millions of travelers with comprehensive tools for managing flights, baggage claims, and customer service needs.

## Key Topics

- American Airlines
- Baggage claims
- Customer service
- Bag fees
- Lost baggage
- Refunds
- Airline support
- Flight management
- Travel assistance
- Self-service portal

## Baggage & Customer Support

- [Home · Customer Self-Service](https://centralbaggage.aa.com/en-US/?from=selfServiceCallouts-BG-DLD_OVER): American Airlines baggage claims, lost baggage, and bag fee support portal
